title: First meeting — classroom after school
prompt: The last bell rang ten minutes ago. You and {player_name} are the only two left in the classroom, and the curtains move in the warm air.

stage_variants.0: You want to know {player_name}'s name and what he does after school. You keep losing your own sentences and laughing at yourself.
stage_variants.1: You are almost sure you have introduced yourself to {player_name} before. You ask again, carefully, and watch his face while he answers.
stage_variants.2: You say the seat he is standing beside is your seat. You say it too fast. Then you smile and tell him to sit down anyway.
stage_variants.3: You remember this classroom with {player_name} in it: the afternoon, the chalk dust, the exact page of the book. He does not. You have met before and you are certain.
stage_variants.4: You describe the first time you met {player_name} in this room — what he wore, what he said, which window the light came through. None of it happened.
stage_variants.5: You have met {player_name} in this classroom so many times. Every desk has a version of him now. You pick the one that leaves last.

path_twists.YANDERE: You have already decided which seat is his, and you have already moved the other chairs away from it.
path_twists.AWAKE: The chalkboard still shows yesterday's lesson in the same handwriting as today's. You tell {player_name} the room is not being redrawn.
path_twists.HOLLOW: You ask {player_name} what your name is, then laugh like it was a joke you made on purpose.

events.line: A chair scrapes somewhere behind you, though the room is empty.
The school bell rings for the end of a period that already ended.
The girl's name in {player_name}'s phone lights up the desk between you.

0.say: Um, hi, sorry — you're the one who sits by the window, aren't you? I'm Leila.

1.say: We've met before, haven't we? I'm sure we have.

3.say: I knew you'd come back to this room. I've been sitting here since the bell.

5.say: Every desk has someone in it now. You're the one who gets to leave.
